items.title: migration_rollback
controls: simplified_agent_contract.enabled activates the collapsed hand_off/block/escalate/scope_route/qa_verdict agent-facing contract
expose_only_simplified_actions removes legacy delivery and proof-request payload fill surfaces from the HUD
proof-from-trace records agent terminal self-tests as observed ProofStore records; authoritative gates still rerun harness-side
hand_off captures the grounded isolated-worktree diff and then runs the stage proof recipe/test plan as the authoritative gate
legacy decision aliases are pruned; simplified contracts accept only collapsed signal decisions
keep_internal_state_machine preserves the old deterministic executor behind the simplified action surface
rollback is operator-safe: disable simplified_agent_contract.enabled to restore closed-choice/normal-worker-flow exposure for in-flight goals
HUD exposes decision_contract_migration so old/new contract mode and rollback state are observable

items.title: operator_control
controls: worker.pause and worker.resume capabilities are registered
GoalRuntimeInstanceStore supports lane park/resume
daemon stop/kill paths exist for foreground runtime control
worker.takeover is a single audited operator workflow: it parks active lanes, pauses peer workers, possesses the target under a lease, and emits operator.takeover.* events
takeover cancellation of an active run is destructive and requires approve_destructive; without it the run remains alive and an approval_required event is recorded
irreversible/prod actions require explicit approval through command safety and promotion gates

items.title: cost_fanout_governance
controls: per-run wall/API/token budgets are validated
mission token ceilings are enforced before opening another persona run
budget incidents route to bounded Neko continuation or scope recovery
swarm hard token ceilings are enforced before opening another persona run once swarm.enabled (implemented + tested; currently gated off — see swarm.enabled)
swarm soft/hard API and token budgets are surfaced in status

items.title: durability_crash_recovery
controls: events, runs, tasks, proofs, role envelopes, worker sessions, and runtime instances are file-backed
archive preserves task/run/proof/context evidence instead of deleting artifacts
stale runs are marked and recoverable through the ticker
mid-run daemon loss is detected by heartbeat TTL; a restarted ticker marks the persisted run stale and opens a stale_run incident before launching duplicate work
run updates are terminal-idempotent: stale in-memory run objects cannot overwrite cancelled/completed/failed runs
same persona/task/stage active run opens are de-duped by RunStore.open_run before another model call starts

items.title: multi_goal_scheduling_backpressure
controls: daemon queue mode is lane-based, so goal activation does not overwrite the target task or force foreground-only starvation
foreground runtime hygiene detects foreign active runs and stale runs before new-goal work proceeds
repo bundle queueing gates dependent launcher/backend handoffs
repo locks and swarm budget summaries are surfaced in status
swarm hard token ceilings block opening another persona run and emit a swarm_budget_exceeded incident (implemented + tested; active once swarm.enabled, currently gated off — see swarm.enabled)
lane summaries include priority, state, current owner/stage, repo locks, and budget counters for resource isolation readback

items.title: observation_path_test_strategy
controls: delivery work_status normalization is unit-tested
trace-observed proof and authoritative gate lanes are unit-tested
repo baseline diff exclusion and worktree isolation are unit-tested
terminal safety and test-tampering fail-closed paths are unit-tested
live blueprint smoke evidence is archived by task id for operator inspection

items.title: recursive_agent_supervised_execution
controls: liveness watchdog cancels hung active runs and opens run_hung incidents without model polling
child.progress/child.blocked/child.returned/child.deploy_failed events are redaction-bounded and wake only parent supervisors
recursive child returns are proof-gated before parent wake proceeds
hierarchical budgets enforce global and per-child token ceilings before opening another child run
ready independent blueprint stages can run as bounded in-process lanes behind swarm.enabled and certification
deploy verification emits child.deploy_failed for assignment-starvation and startup-evidence failures
production enablement is ledger-gated by the existing unattended burn-in certification target

Backend specialist for contract and deploy proof.
QA verifier for local and staging evidence.
Final reviewer for production rollout proof and release verdict.

stages.title: Scope
stages.objective: Clarify production scope, non-goals, ordered proof gates, and rollback expectations.

stages.title: Backend Contract
stages.objective: Produce or update backend contract proof before frontend consumption.

stages.title: Frontend Implementation
stages.objective: Implement the Launcher/frontend side against the backend contract.

stages.title: Local Self Test
stages.objective: Run local deterministic proof covering backend contract and frontend implementation.

stages.title: QA Verify
stages.objective: Verify attached backend, frontend, and local proof before staging.

stages.title: Staging Smoke
stages.objective: Validate the release candidate in staging before production rollout.

stages.title: Production Rollout Proof
stages.objective: Attach ordered production rollout proof and rollback notes.

stages.title: Final Verdict
stages.objective: Review production proof and record final release verdict.

blueprints.title: Neko default root script
blueprints.description: Root node authors stages dynamically for the current goal.

blueprints.title: Neko Dev QA Basic
blueprints.description: Mission lead scopes work, builder implements it, verifier checks proof.

slots.description: Mission lead that clarifies scope and routes recovery.
Agent that implements the scoped work.
Agent that verifies implementation and proof.

stages.title: Scope
stages.objective: Clarify scope, acceptance criteria, and proof expectation.

stages.title: Implement
stages.objective: Implement the scoped work and attach proof.

stages.title: Verify
stages.objective: Verify implementation and proof.

blueprints.title: Neko Single Dev
blueprints.description: Neko scopes one bounded repo lane, then one Dev specialist implements and proves it.

slots.description: Mission lead that confirms scope and releases one specialist.
Single Dev specialist for the requested repo scope.

stages.title: Scope
stages.objective: Confirm scope, acceptance criteria, proof expectations, and release the single repo lane.

stages.title: Implementation
stages.objective: Implement or document the requested repo slice and attach the focused proof named by the goal.

blueprints.title: Neko Two Dev Default
blueprints.description: Neko scopes, then fans out to Backend Dev and Launcher Dev as parallel branches and waits for both to return before it joins and closes. QA is not part of the default path.

slots.description: Mission lead that scopes, deploys both dev branches in parallel, and joins their results.

stages.title: Scope
stages.objective: Clarify scope, acceptance criteria, proof expectation, and which Dev specialist owns each slice, then release both dev branches.

stages.title: Backend Implementation
stages.objective: Implement or verify backend/API/data contract changes needed by the mission; pass with an explicit no-backend-change note when not applicable.

stages.title: Launcher Implementation
stages.objective: Implement the launcher/runtime slice and attach focused proof.

blueprints.title: One-Agent Smoke Blueprint
blueprints.description: Smallest headless blueprint flow for a single bound builder.

slots.description: Agent that performs the smoke objective.

stages.title: Build
stages.objective: Complete the requested smoke objective and report proof.

blueprints.title: Two-Agent Build/Verify Blueprint
blueprints.description: Builder produces a result, verifier checks it, failures route back to builder.

stages.title: Implement
stages.objective: Implement or fix the requested scope.

stages.title: Verify
stages.objective: Verify the implementation with concrete evidence.

blueprints.title: Visual UI QA
blueprints.description: UI implementation flow that requires command proof and visual screenshot or video proof before QA approval.

slots.description: Agent that implements the UI change and captures visual proof.
Agent that verifies the UI proof and final behavior.

stages.title: Implement UI
stages.objective: Implement the UI change and attach focused test proof plus a screenshot or video.

stages.title: Visual Verify
stages.objective: Verify the screenshot or video is nonblank, current, and covers the requested UI behavior.
